newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen range-bound on low sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen range-bound on low sales.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were expected to open little changed and move in a tight range in retail driven trade, as bigger buyers stayed on the sidelines due to a lack of sellers, brokers said.
"Retailers should dominate only because big quantities are not available, as sellers hold out for higher prices," said a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Sellers are hanging on to shares as first quarter 1997 corporate results, which are coming out now, are good, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the all share index closed 0.7 points lower at 726.8, on turnover of 39 million rupees.

"There is foreign interest among selected stocks where corporate results have been good, but sellers are holding out for big premiums and scaring away the buyers," said a trader at Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
